mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate and rising unemployment rate signals a dual stress on monetary policy and labor market, which together compress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1800.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST declines and INDPRO declines simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0), the supply-side contraction signals reduced manufacturing output and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
